progress.description: Normalised timeline position. Drive it from useCurrentFrame().

speed.description: Speed multiplier on the progress timeline. 2 finishes at the halfway mark.

delay.description: Share of the timeline before motion starts.

theme.description: Light or dark role set. Legacy palette objects are also accepted.

fontFamily.description: Font id (sans, serif, mono…) or any CSS font-family. Default inherits.

background.description: Backdrop. "none" keeps the transparent legacy behaviour; any CSS colour also works.

grain.description: Film grain over the backdrop (needs a background).

grid.description: Dotted grid on the backdrop (needs a background).

style.description: Inline styles on the effect root.

categories.name: Reveals & Masks
categories.blurb: Bring content on screen through a shape, pattern or blur.

categories.name: Numbers & Progress
categories.blurb: Counters, rings and meters that read at a glance.

categories.name: Transitions
categories.blurb: Slices, folds and peels between states.

categories.name: Light & Texture
categories.blurb: Sheens, scans, CRT, halftone and colour fields.

categories.name: UI Stories
categories.blurb: Product-interface moments: chat, forms, toggles, rankings.

categories.name: Data & Charts
categories.blurb: Series, candles, timelines and fills driven by your data.

categories.name: Primitives
categories.blurb: Low-level building blocks with explicit geometry.

saint-orange.name: Saint Orange
saint-orange.description: The original orange and cream look of this library, kept as-is.

graphite.name: Graphite
graphite.description: Neutral product UI: quiet greys with one cobalt accent.

editorial.name: Editorial
editorial.description: Printed-matter warmth: bone paper, black ink, a single vermilion.

indigo-signal.name: Indigo Signal
indigo-signal.description: Indigo, black and white with a lime signal colour for one key moment.

monochrome.name: Monochrome
monochrome.description: Grayscale only. Motion and type carry everything.

ember.name: Late Ember
ember.description: Warm glow on near-black; a dark-first sibling of Saint Orange.

stylePresets.name: Saint Orange
stylePresets.description: Original cream and orange, crisp sans, no grain. Matches the old gallery.

stylePresets.name: Saint Night
stylePresets.description: Saint Orange on warm black with a little film grain.

stylePresets.name: Studio Graphite
stylePresets.description: Product-launch neutral. Dark graphite, cobalt focus, brisk timing.

stylePresets.name: Broadsheet
stylePresets.description: Editorial serif on bone paper, unhurried, with a print-like tooth.

stylePresets.name: Signal
stylePresets.description: Indigo night with a lime moment. Mono labels, fast in, long hold.

stylePresets.name: Ink Only
stylePresets.description: Monochrome and calm. Good for checking that motion reads without colour.

stylePresets.name: Late Ember
stylePresets.description: Glowing warm accents on near-black, heavier grain, slower settle.

silhouette.description: SVG elements that define the shape.

dx.description: Depth projection on x, in SVG units.

dy.description: Depth projection on y, in SVG units.

effects.name: Extrude
effects.description: Give any SVG silhouette (text, paths) solid depth. Pass `contours` for lit, rotating walls instead.
notes: Not progress-driven: animate dx/dy yourself.

from.description: Start pose {x, y, width, height, radius} in composition px.

stationary.description: Keep the starting center fixed throughout the morph.

effects.name: Shape Transform
effects.description: A centered shape smoothly morphs between circle and rounded rectangle. Translation is opt-in.

lightMode.description: Paint on a light background instead of additive glow.

paletteOnly.description: Use only the three colours (no darkening).

effects.name: Molten Metal
effects.description: WebGL liquid-metal field. Driven by the Remotion frame; colours and flow are props.
notes: Uses useCurrentFrame; render with --gl=angle or swiftshader in headless renders.

noiseScale.description: Noise frequency: low is coarse, high is fine.

effects.name: Noise Dissolve
effects.description: Content breaks into fractal noise and disappears.
notes: Exit effect: progress 1 means fully hidden.
Legacy: a numeric `grain` is read as noise frequency on this effect.

lead.description: Accent wave running ahead of the reveal.

effects.name: Liquid Wipe
effects.description: An organic blob grows from a point, led by an accent wave.

pattern.description: Ordered Bayer pattern or random cells (legacy).

effects.name: Dither Reveal
effects.description: Content appears through an ordered dither that sweeps across it.

stagger.description: Share of the timeline used for stagger.

effects.name: Paper Flip
effects.description: Tiles flip down from their top edge in sequence, with paper shading.
notes: Each child is one tile.

effects.name: CRT
effects.description: Chromatic split, scanlines, vignette and a rolling refresh bar.
notes: `progress` is optional; without it the effect is static.

guides.description: Accent guide lines around the focus slot.

effects.name: Fisheye Picker
effects.description: A drum picker: items curve away from a focus slot with depth, blur and fade.

effects.name: Halftone Stairs
effects.description: Halftone columns rise as a staircase from the bottom edge.

ring.description: Accent ring on the opening edge.

effects.name: Iris
effects.description: Circular aperture reveal with a travelling accent ring.

presets.name: From the corner
presets.description: Opens from bottom-left with a softer edge.

edge.description: Accent sliver on each leading edge.

effects.name: Strip Wipe
effects.description: Bands wipe in one after another, each led by an accent sliver.

effects.name: Focus Pull
effects.description: Rack focus: content resolves from a soft, slightly oversized blur.

effects.name: Sheen
effects.description: A light sweep across content: wide soft bloom with a bright core.

effects.name: Orbit
effects.description: Items circle on a tilted ellipse with depth: far items shrink, blur and dim.
notes: Each child is one orbiting item. progress 0→1 is one full turn.

effects.name: Glowing Trace
effects.description: Draws an SVG path with a bloom, a hot head and a faint guide track.

effects.name: Color Wave
effects.description: A crest of accent colour travels through the text, lifting each letter it passes.

presets.name: Slow serif
presets.description: Editorial pace with a serif face.

effects.name: Letter Swing
effects.description: Letters swing down from a top-left hinge and settle on a spring.

presets.name: Slow serif
presets.description: Editorial pace with a serif face.

churn.description: Share of the timeline each character scrambles.

effects.name: Scramble
effects.description: Decoder text: characters churn through a glyph pool and lock in left to right.

effects.name: Tracking Reveal
effects.description: Wide-tracked, blurred letters pull together into the final word shape.

effects.name: Roll Counter
effects.description: Odometer counter: each digit column rolls, with blur proportional to its speed.

end.description: Share of the ring left at progress 1.

effects.name: Compression Ring
effects.description: A full ring compresses to a sliver while a lagging trail arc follows it in.

effects.name: Segment Fill
effects.description: Skewed segments light up in sequence, each with a small spring pop.

effects.name: Depth Fly In
effects.description: Content flies in from depth with a 3D turn and atmospheric blur.

effects.name: Fold Away
effects.description: Content folds back on its top hinge, darkening as it turns away.
notes: Exit effect: progress 1 means folded away.

effects.name: Dock
effects.description: Content travels on an arc to a docked corner and shrinks.
notes: Legacy: without targetScale, a numeric `scale` is read as the target scale.

effects.name: Moving Blobs
effects.description: Soft colour fields drift on Lissajous paths. Fills its parent.

effects.name: Dot Drift
effects.description: A dotted field drifts diagonally behind the content.

effects.name: Scan
effects.description: A glowing scan line sweeps down; scanned content is tinted.

effects.description: Copies ride a shallow 3D ellipse with depth blur.

effects.name: Border Runner
effects.description: A comet of light runs around a card border.

effects.name: Camera Push
effects.description: Exponential camera pull-back with lateral drift.

effects.name: Fan Spread

effects.name: Accordion

effects.name: Checker Fold
effects.description: Tiles fold up in a diagonal wave.

effects.name: Path Follow

effects.name: Grid Ripple
effects.description: A ring of scale passes through a grid of copies.

effects.name: Trail Echo
effects.description: Fading, blurred echoes follow the lead copy.

effects.name: Corner Peel
effects.description: The bottom-right corner folds diagonally across the entire page, revealing the scene underneath.
notes: Exit effect: progress 1 means gone. Match width and height to the source scene.

effects.name: Split Slide
effects.description: Top and bottom halves slide in from opposite sides.

effects.name: Word Gap Insert
effects.description: A gap opens between two words and an object springs into it.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

glyphs.description: Custom SVG glyphs instead of text.

effects.name: Glyph Selection
effects.description: A vector selection box turns filled glyphs into outlines.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Proof Stack Tumble
effects.description: Proof cards tumble off a stack one by one; the last one stays.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Selection Roulette

notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Leaderboard Promotion
effects.description: A highlighted row lifts, overtakes the others and settles at the top.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Form Send Flight

notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Folder Catch
effects.description: Cards drop behind a folder rim, each landing with a pulse.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Delivery Status
effects.description: Sent, delivered and seen checks, then the message body expands.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Candlestick HUD
effects.description: OHLC candles draw one by one with a live price and volume readout.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Tracking Line Chart
effects.description: A live series draws with a tracking camera, a pulsing tip and a delta readout.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Token Pot Fill
effects.description: Each arriving token bumps the counter and the pot fill together.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

segments.description: Segments with label and optional color; overrides labels.

effects.name: Timeline Rise
effects.description: Time segments fill in sequence, then a two-point rise with a percentage.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

effects.name: Logo Landing
effects.description: A mark falls, squashes on contact, rebounds and settles on its shadow.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.

darkScreen.description: Switch to a dark screen at checksStart.

effects.name: Device Conditions
effects.description: A browser shell becomes a phone; dark-mode and network rows tick in.
notes: Draws in a 600 × 260 viewBox and fills its parent box.
